meta.description: Igris tizimining barcha boshqaruv protokollarining manifesti. v2.1: D1 API validatsiya + T2 mtime-cache + A4 web grounding + A1-2 run-verification (2026-09-13).
meta.verification: D1 32 + T2 10 + A4 21 + A1-2 13 yangi test; regressiya 160+ test — 2026-09-13

protocols.name: IgrisAgent
protocols.summary: Har bir so'rovni boshqaradi: resolve() (deterministik + LLM fallback), chat() (turbo/llm+tools/offline), chat_stream() (turbo/plain-stream/tool). Pipeline, RAG recall, compliance, graceful degradation, CAG/MAG integratsiyasi.
fixed_this_session: llm_failed UnboundLocalError — offline rejimda chat() crash qilardi
_cacheable_out junk-guard eskirgan edi (5 marker bilan kengaytirildi)
fallback matn kontrakti + extract_code doimiy chaqiruv

protocols.name: AgentExecutor
protocols.summary: Plan → act → observe → correct ReAct sikli. max_iter=8, max_retries=2, quality gate (_verify_deliverable + corrective_pass), capability-gap fallback (use_skill/mcp/request_human), hooks on_plan/on_step_start/on_step_done/on_task_done.
fixed_this_session: A1-2: run-verification — .py fayl izolyatsiyada ishga tushiriladi; runtime xatolar gate'dan o'tmaydi

protocols.name: TaskSupervisor + Composition + Todo
protocols.summary: Murakkab vazifalar: decomposition → DAG → node execution → summarise. Composition pipeline: plan/read/edit/test/review (plan_then_execute), max_iter=8, max_repair=3. Todo: /todo list|add|complete (todos.json).

protocols.name: HarmFilter + Safety + Corrigibility
protocols.summary: Harm-filter 2.10 (aniq zarar chegarasi, rad + sabab, LLM/xotiraga yo'q). safety.has_suspicious (injection naqshlar). Corrigibility: avtonomiya NOL. Tool darajasi: DENY_PATTERNS, realpath sandbox, python deny-list. 3 qatlam MCP output-guard.

protocols.name: WebStrategy
protocols.summary: Eng arzon vosita chizig'i: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob → web_fetch → ask_web_ai → real browser (CDP). BUTTON_SAFETY_TIERS (1/2/3), deep research polling, download check, BLOCKED/OBSTRUCTED, HTTP status+Content-Type tahlil, chat'da avtomatik browser tool.
fixed_this_session: A4: web_verify.py — javob manba grounding tekshiruvi (deterministik, LLM yo'q)

protocols.name: SVGAssurance
protocols.summary: SVG sifat tekshiruvi: gradient/soya/fon/markazlash/margin/chegara/ranglar/uslub. style_comment: flat/realistic/cartoon. Fail-guard + redraw_note + _fake_draw_claim (soxta 'chizdim' blok).
shortcomings: Dp7: predmet kutubxonasi tor (12 PNG + 19 SVG)

protocols.name: HooksAndEvents + Watchdog
protocols.summary: DEFAULT_BUS: on_plan/on_step_start/on_step_done/on_task_done (ixtiyoriy). Watchdog 16 funksiya: 4s poll, avtomatik restart ~20-30s, rate-limit, boot-grace, marker handshake, single-instance qulf, atomik holat.

protocols.name: CAG&MAG
protocols.summary: CAG: o'zgarmas kalit, faqat sifatli javoblar (_cacheable_out + fail-guard), keshlangan ham repair'dan o'tadi, TURBO/MAG/lag keshlanmaydi. MAG: L1+L2+RAG sessiya konteksti.

protocols.name: MemoryControl
protocols.summary: L1 + L2 + RAG + CAG + MAG. Faqat sifatli javoblar (fail-guard 7 joyda). Dedup. Snapshot integrity. Cleanup. Recall tozalash (has_suspicious + PoisoningProtection).
fixed_this_session: T2: load_documents mtime-cache (faqat o'zgargan fayllar) + remove_source API'lari

protocols.name: Tool&MCP
protocols.summary: ToolRegistry (DEFAULT_REGISTRY) + Workspace (realpath sandbox) + vositalar (read/write/list/apply_patch/python_exec/run_command/web_fetch). MCP: art, ui_builder, skills, database, filesystem, github, redis, websocket. Transport xatosida run() fallback. Barcha MCP chiqishi tozalanadi.

protocols.name: RequirementExtractor
protocols.summary: Requirement + RequirementExtractor: til/format/chuqurlik/intent (math/weather/draw/web/summarize/code/file/compose_ui) JSON. CAG kesh 'req:<message>'. LLM + deterministik fallback (exception bermaydi). extract_fast (LLM'siz).

protocols.name: IntelligenceCore + modullar
protocols.summary: IntelligenceCore: adapt_system, reasoning_suffix, observe, screen, self_eval (SelfEvaluator signallari: engine/status/verified/resolver_score/avg_logprob; evaluate() 1 marta — kesh), creative multi-temperature, quick_math/weather delegatsiya, fail-guard.
fixed_this_session: grounding signali (A4): SelfEvaluator + IntelligenceCore — grounded +0.10 / ungrounded -0.15

protocols.name: QuickPaths (math + weather)
protocols.summary: Math: safe_math (AST) + MATH_EXPR_RE — LLM/brauzer keraksiz. Weather: Open-Meteo geocoding+forecast (kalit yo'q, 2-4s), manba ko'rsatiladi. DIQQAT: quick_math.py/quick_weather.py fayllari MAVJUD EMAS — funksionallik igris_agent ichida (manifest v1 xatosi tuzatildi).

protocols.name: MemoryFayllari
protocols.summary: Fizik xotira: L1 short-turn/session, L2 solution-memory, snapshots (memory_state+metadata). Faqat sifatli yozuv, dedup, snapshot integrity, cleanup.
